about.headline: Automation that feels like child's play
about.heroBody: We believe industrial automation shouldn’t be complicated. Bioversee makes it easy to get started, whether you’re a DIY maker, a student, or a professional in the field.
about.productTitle: The same lab in your pocket
about.productBody: Devices, inbox, and account, with live updates so you can respond from anywhere.
about.webTitle: Control your process from the browser
about.webBody: Actuators on the left, live sensor charts on the right, and your process in the middle. Built for monitoring and control in one view.
about.phoneCaption: Tap Devices, Inbox, or Account to explore the app, the same way you would on your phone.
about.piBody: Run Bioversee on a Raspberry Pi at the bench — local process control that stays in sync with the web and mobile apps.
about.piCaption: A compact edge device for local monitoring and control when you are next to the process.
about.piDownloadHint: Open the install guide, run the setup script on your Pi, then finish the wiring wizard.
about.storyTitle: Built by an engineer, for engineers
about.founderBody: Biochemical engineer aiming to make industrial bioprocess automation as easy as child's play.
about.companyBody: Bioversee aims to create an affordable and playful solution for industrial automation, and a proper educational tool for engineering students.
about.ctaBody: Sign in to create devices, invite collaborators, and keep everything in sync on web and phone.
